title: Module-valued sheaves on a small sieve site are Grothendieck abelian
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a small category with a Grothendieck topology $J$ given by covering sieves: a sieve is a set of arrows with common target closed under precomposition, the maximal sieve covers, and covering sieves are stable under pullback of sieves and satisfy transitivity. No fibre products in $\mathcal C$ or subcanonicity are assumed. Use the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative ring. Let $\mathcal S$ be the category of functors $\mathcal C^{\mathrm{op}}\to\operatorname{Mod}_\Lambda$ satisfying the sheaf condition for covering sieves: every compatible family of sections indexed by all arrows in a covering sieve has a unique amalgamation. Morphisms are $\Lambda$-linear natural transformations. Then $\mathcal S$ is Grothendieck abelian [def-sp-grothendieck-abelian]: it is abelian, has all small colimits, filtered colimits are exact, and it has a generator.
